mapper.select: SELECT id, post_id, language, title, content_html, content_text, updated_at FROM bbs_post_i18n WHERE post_id = #{postId} ORDER BY language
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bbs_post_i18n (post_id, language, title, content_html, content_text, updated_at) VALUES (#{postId}, #{language}, #{title}, #{contentHtml}, #{contentText}, NOW()) ON CONFLICT (post_id, language) DO UPDATE SET title = EXCLUDED.title, content_html = EXCLUDED.content_html, content_text = EXCLUDED.content_text, updated_at = NOW()
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM bbs_post_i18n WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND language = #{language}
